clues.text: At the gateway of Hebron, he pulled Abner aside as if to talk privately, then stabbed him.
Finding Absalom still alive and caught in an oak tree, he thrust three spears through his heart.
Following King David's letter during the siege, he placed Uriah the Hittite where the strongest enemy soldiers were.
David promised command to whoever first struck down a Jebusite, and this man went up first and became chief.
After backing Adonijah against Solomon, he fled to the tent of the LORD and took hold of the horns of the altar.
Seeing that King David longed for Absalom, he sent to Tekoa for a wise woman to pose as a mourner.
While pursuing Sheba son of Bichri, he caught Amasa off guard and stabbed him with a dagger.
